text.p: Barrington Petroleum Ltd said on Monday it agreed to a proposed C$62.3-million takeover of junior oil company Cube Energy Corp.
Under the friendly deal, Barrington plans to offer C$13 cash for each Cube common share and assume C$4.2 in long-term Cube debt, it said.

Cube said its board of directors were recommending the firm's shareholders accept the deal. It also said it agreed to pay Barrington a non-completion fee of C$2 million should a competing offer be successful.

Barrington said its bid was conditional on a minimum of 66-2/3 percent of Cube's fully-diluted shares being tendered to the offer. Shareholders representing 35 percent of Cube's stock had already signed lock-up agreements with the suitor, it said.
The offer was expected to be mailed on or before March 17, Barrington said.
Barrington said the total cost of acquiring Cube's 4.47 million shares will be C$58.1 million. Cube also has C$4.2 million of long-term debt and C$900,000 in preferred shares.
Under the deal, Cube agreed to redeem all the outstanding preferred shares before the offer expired, the firms said.

Cube's main operations, which account for 70 percent of its oil and gas reserves, are in the Zama and Larne areas of northwestern Alberta, Lloydminster in eastern Alberta and the Senlac area in west Saskatchewan.

The companies said Cube had undeveloped landholdings of 90,400 net acres, to which Barrington assigned a value of C$7.2 million. Cube was producing 24.5 million cubic feet per day of natural gas and 625 barrels per day of oil and gas liquids, the firms said.
Cube also expected to bring on shut-in gas production of about 7.0 MMCFD from its properties.
Barrington said it already identified over 50 net drilling prospects on Cube's undeveloped acreage.
A total of 83 percent of Cube's properties fit into two of Barrington's core regions in northwestern Alberta and east central Alberta, the companies said.
Sharest in both companies were halted on the Toronto Stock Exchange for the announcement. Cube last traded up 0.50 at 12, while Barrington was off 0.10 at 5.50.
